title: Phase 1: Reserved-code drift fix + DSL Field-access symmetry + defined() fix
description:
v0.1.0 blocker. Internal fixes that change error-emission contracts.

Scope: (1) Rename MDATRON-E0001/E0002 per spec at DESIGN-MDATRON.md:116-117/506-514 (currently swapped); reserve E0070, E0080. (2) Amend the reserved-codes table to match implementation. (3) Add code-allocation lint - test that every emission site emits a reserved code. (4) Fix Field-on-Object-missing-key to return Null (symmetric with existing Field-on-Null at mdatron-core/src/dsl/expr.rs:224) - this was M4 PE F1 root-cause finding. (5) Revert the schema-tightening on supplements_in_scope/supplements_applied (was a reactive fix; the DSL change makes optional-field check safe). (6) Drop defined() empty-string carve-out at mdatron-core/src/dsl/expr.rs:322-330 - defined() becomes strict not-Null semantic.

Acceptance: every error code emitted by mdatron resolves to a reserved-codes entry; Field access on missing keys returns Null (test fixture exercises both branches); defined("") returns true; vsdd corpus still passes mdatron verify after schema reverts.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 1.
